Everyday tools / Finance

PayRadar

Phoenix-powered subscription, instalment and recurring payment tracking.

A Kotlin Android app for rent, bills, subscriptions and instalments, with offline records and local reminders. The former web app has been retired.

Test build

PayRadar Android native — screen tour

A silent tour made from authentic Kotlin Android emulator screenshots: home, payment editor, Material 3 calendar and settings. This is not a live interaction recording or a physical-device test. It does not show the retired web interface.

The need

Scattered recurring payments make renewals and total spending hard to see.

Approach

Phoenix (Ivory / Ember) design system, Material 3 calendar date picker, local encrypted vault, payment summaries and native Android reminders. Optional Google/Supabase cloud sync available.

Current scope and limits

Android closed test. Google Play enrolment is required. The linked page is a download guide, not a browser payment app. Cloud sync is not server-blind end-to-end encryption. Version on the published access page: 2.1.3-phoenix (versionCode 10).

Published information checked on 5 November 2026. An accessible interface is not evidence that every workflow has passed end-to-end testing.
